lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: If your vehicle is stranded in winter snow or mud, what must you verify before running engine for heat?

options.text: Turn off all interior dashboard air conditioning fans to save battery current
Verify the vehicle transmission fluid is filled to the maximum dipstick mark
Remove the vehicle engine air filter to allow extra oxygen into combustion
Ensure exhaust tailpipe is clear of snow or debris; cracked tailpipe leaks fumes inside
